    Solana vs Avalanche (SOL vs AVAX)

    As of November 22, 2026 (Binance daily close): Solana closed at $70.730 and Avalanche at $6.690, so 1 SOL = 10.57 AVAX.

    ⚡ Live SOL price ⚡ Live AVAX price 🔁 Convert SOL to AVAX

    SOL vs AVAX: what the numbers show

    Solana's market cap of about $41.13B is 14 times Avalanche's ($2.97B); they rank #7 and #21 of the 114 coins tracked here. Over the past year Solana fell 44.6% and Avalanche fell 49.4%, a gap of 4.9 percentage points in Solana's favour. Avalanche was the more volatile of the two over the last 30 days (82.4% annualized against 63.5%). Within the year, Solana's largest fall between daily closes was 57.6% and Avalanche's was 60.7%. On November 22, 2026 Solana was 51.8% below its 52-week high and Avalanche 55.5% below its own. In 8 of the last 12 complete months, Solana did better than Avalanche. Measured against Bitcoin's daily moves over 90 days, Solana had a correlation of 0.85 and Avalanche 0.59.
